DREAM WORKER — Issue #90: Delete Dead Baileys Logger from Core

## Instructions
1. Read the wish file: .genie/wishes/remove-baileys-logger-from-core/WISH.md
2. Branch from dev: git checkout dev && git pull origin dev && git checkout -b chore/remove-baileys-logger
3. Execute ALL deliverables from Group 1:
   - Delete file packages/core/src/logger/adapters/baileys.ts
   - Delete empty directory packages/core/src/logger/adapters/
   - Remove ./logger/adapters/baileys export from packages/core/package.json
   - Remove src/logger/adapters/baileys.ts ignore from knip.json
4. Run the validation commands from the wish file
5. Run make check — if it fails, fix and retry (max 3 attempts)
6. Once CI green, create PR: gh pr create --base dev --title "chore(core): remove dead Baileys logger adapter (GH#90)" --body "..."
7. Report back: DONE with PR URL, or BLOCKED with reason

IMPORTANT: Do NOT push to main. PR must target dev.
